method.description: Gaussian at the 10 post-ReLU positions (stem output + 9 block outputs), plateau schedule, no resolution change.

gaussian.units: pixels of the feature map at the site; the reference levels scaled by 96/32 so the blur covers the same fraction of the image extent as on CIFAR-10

source.label: Blur after every ReLU, annealed to zero

notes: transfer preset: not trained, not validated
insertion mapping: input of blocks.2, as in the reference; on a 96x96 image that site runs at 96, so reference_resolution is 96 and not 32
sigma x3 and resolution x3 from the CIFAR-10 reference; schedule boundaries x2 for 60 epochs
normalisation statistics pinned from the training images
optimizer swapped from sgd lr 0.005 wd 0.0005 to adam lr 0.001 wd 0; every other decision is this dataset's study unchanged

lr is the textbook value, NOT matched to the SGD recipe's difficulty: SGD lr 0.005 is ~1/20 of a normal rate and is what keeps the control undertrained. Expect less headroom here; read gaps against this column's own control, and rule out a better-optimized baseline before concluding the optimizer broke the methods.
